arguments.head: codex/autonomy-completion
arguments.title: fix: enforce delegated delivery and recovery boundaries
arguments.body:
## Summary

Connect delegated delivery to the public run interface and close the source-integrity and recovery defects found in the full autonomy reconciliation. Grants are typed and bounded, journal intent precedes source writes, uncertain outcomes require reconciliation, and public recovery verifies source, workspace and complete artifacts. Engineering and telemetry remain optional ports.

Includes neutral engineering schemas, strict terminal receipts, optional native Codex structured-output binding, privacy protection, bounded compact context, executable adoption guidance and reproducible efficiency measurements. The repository routing uses Codex while Agy is unavailable.

## Implemented issues

Closes #297
Closes #300

## Related issues

Refs #301, #302, #303, #304, #260. Those aggregate qualification issues remain open; this PR implements their corrective composition without claiming the original live matrix or performance targets complete.

## Workflow evidence

Workflow-status comment: https://github.com/smota/agentflow-sdlc/issues/301#issuecomment-5865551409
Handover comments: exception: one consolidated workflow-status comment plus explicit scoped helper contracts; same-platform helpers are disclosed below.
Role-pass summary: analyst/planner preserved A1-A9; developer implemented scoped corrections; tester ran regressions and actual CLI/source probes; reviewer returned privacy, path-scope and recovery races to implementation; final evidence synthesis retains external qualification limits.
Validation evidence: docs/maintainers/process-autonomy-completion.md and CI on this candidate. Local scratch logs are not durable approval records.

## Agent review

- Implemented by: codex
- Launcher: codex
- Executor: codex-cli
- Transport: local-cli
- Delegation boundary: current-session
- Model / runtime: Codex desktop parent; gpt-6-sol implementation helpers, gpt-6-luna bounded docs/review; separate native gpt-5.6-luna CLI probe
- Review: self-review
- Workflow profile: standard
- Merge owner: human/operator
- Mode: multi-agent
- Self-review disclosure: Codex authored and reviewed the changes with separate read-only helpers. Grok supplied independent architecture advice, not final code or human acceptance. No human-review attestation is claimed.
- Regression test: added

The user authorized autonomous completion and experimental merge. That delegation does not modify generic high-assurance policy. Live Codex write qualification remains blocked by this host's effective read-only sandbox; the installed Meshloop binary lacks required integration capabilities. New edit dispatch defaults to refusal without qualified capability and explicit source-evidence disclosure.

## Role attribution matrix

| Phase | Role | Planned owner | Actual platform | Executor | Context boundary | Independence boundary | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | analyst | codex | codex | codex-cli | current-session | not-applicable | pass |
| 2 | architect | codex | grok | grok-cli | local-cli-child-process | independent | pass: advisory local-cooperative architecture, not production qualification |
| 3 | implementation-planner | codex | codex | codex-cli | current-session | not-applicable | pass |
| 4 | developer | codex | codex | codex-cli | forked-context | not-applicable | pass |
| 5 | tester | codex | codex | codex-cli | current-session | not-applicable | pass |
| 6 | review | codex | codex | codex-cli | forked-context | self-review | pass |

Grok round one reached its limit without a verdict; rounds two and three completed. Round three reasoned from stated dispositions and did not re-inspect the final tree. Helper model selection is distinct from the live CLI's supported model.

## CI-equivalent validation

- Status: passed
Commands: `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run`; `node scripts/validate-docs.mjs`; `node scripts/validate-role-catalog.mjs`; `node scripts/verify-agent-workflow.mjs`; `node scripts/verify-hooks.mjs`; `node scripts/validate-config-authority.mjs`; `node scripts/audit-reachability.mjs`; `node scripts/package-parity-smoke.mjs`.

The integrated telemetry workload preserved the same accepted observations in disabled/enabled/offline modes. Its paired enabled p95 overhead exceeded 5%; this is a disclosed unmet performance target, not a passing performance claim. Cache append calls fell 31.5% in a fake-source benchmark, below the 50% live HTTP target. Compact-context fixture bytes fell 84.4%; live transport savings remain unmeasured.

## Follow-up issues

- #301: remaining live business-effect/fault and source-recovery qualification; no hard spending ceiling or authenticated human issuer.
- #302: compatible optional Meshloop runtime and standalone/integrated lifecycle qualification; native Codex write/cancel qualification on a capable host.
- #303: observed live request reduction and <=5% p95 telemetry target, unobserved analytics dimensions.
- #304: remaining full original adoption/fault matrix and supported runtime/host qualification.

Rollback: revert these scoped product commits; preserve coordination history. v1 remains readable and segmented migration is explicit, never an automatic config flip. Do not delete unknown Git locks or local authored files.
